title: Exploding Note
body:
Syntax: exploding note <target>

Description: Attaches a consumed Exploding Note to a target. It detonates after two combat pulses for 28-46 damage unless disabled. Requires a carried exploding note. Bukijutsu unlocks at level 25. Costs 25 Chakra and 12 Stamina; 6 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
